description: List the websites currently being monitored for AI visibility on a schedule. Use this when someone asks "what am I tracking," "which sites am I monitoring," "how many monitoring slots am I using," or wants to see their tracked domains. Returns each tracked domain with its cadence and active state, plus slots used and remaining (out of 5). Requires a Website Auditor subscription ($10/month; eligible new customers get a 7-day free trial — payment method required, no charge until the trial ends) — if the user doesn't have one, call get_sample_audit first to show them the exact output format, free and with no API key.
name: list_tracked_sites

last_audited_at.description: The date of the last scheduled run, stamped when the scheduler claims it and before the audit runs. It does not say how that run ended: it may still be going, or may have failed, been skipped or measured nothing of the business.

title: List monitored sites
